body.query: @concat('Resources | where type =~ ''microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'' | extend OSHostName=tostring(properties.osProfile.computerName) | extend ShortOSHostName=tostring(split(OSHostName,''.'')[0]) | where toupper(name) == ''',outputs('Normalize_Current_Hostname'),''' or toupper(OSHostName) == ''',outputs('Normalize_Current_Hostname'),''' or toupper(ShortOSHostName) == ''',outputs('Normalize_Current_Hostname'),''' | join kind=leftouter (ResourceContainers | where type =~ ''microsoft.resources/subscriptions'' | project subscriptionId, SubscriptionName=name) on subscriptionId | project Hostname=OSHostName, VMName=name, SubscriptionId=subscriptionId, SubscriptionName, ResourceGroup=resourceGroup, Location=location, ResourceId=id, OSType=tostring(properties.storageProfile.osDisk.osType), Tags=tags')

@concat('Resources | where type =~ ''microsoft.compute/virtualmachines'' | where id =~ ''',outputs('VM_Record')?['ResourceId'],''' | mv-expand bagexpansion=array tags | where isnotempty(tags) | project VMName=name, TagName=tostring(tags[0]), TagValue=tostring(tags[1]), subscriptionId, resourceGroup, id')

@concat('ResourceContainers | where type =~ ''microsoft.resources/subscriptions'' | where subscriptionId =~ ''',outputs('VM_Record')?['SubscriptionId'],''' | mv-expand bagexpansion=array tags | where isnotempty(tags) | project SubscriptionName=name, TagName=tostring(tags[0]), TagValue=tostring(tags[1]), subscriptionId, id')
